visual: One draft chain appears, then a plausible branch competes for a limited verifier slot.
narration: Drafting one chain is cheap. But which alternative paths deserve verification?

visual: Context ends before orange root b; masked slots appear after it; features arrow comes only from context.
narration: D D tree starts with a bonus token, b, selected but not yet processed by the target. Available target features describe only the preceding context.

visual: A single pass changes three masks into simultaneous distributions; small bars reveal A and B probabilities.
narration: D Flash predicts all three masked positions in one block-diffusion pass. Here are toy token distributions.

visual: Draft formula builds from three shared marginals; target formula adds earlier chosen tokens to its condition.
narration: Multiplying shared marginals gives the surrogate Q. Unlike Q, the target conditions on actual preceding tokens.

purpose: Set root convention and prefix identity
visual: Root and five empty budget marks; A then AA nodes show final-token A at different paths.
narration: Five speculative nodes plus the root: six verifier inputs. Nodes represent prefixes; circles contain actual tokens.

purpose: Compute prefix mass with operands visible
visual: Highlight .60 and .70; copy into product .60 × .70 and reveal .420 beside AA.
narration: Score A A by multiplying point six by point seven: point four two. This is a prefix probability under Q, not target confidence.

visual: Extend AA to AAA; .420 × .80 becomes .336; descending staircase links parent and child.
narration: Extend by point eight to get point three three six. With probabilities strictly between zero and one, descendants always score below their ancestors.

visual: Reset ghost previews; queue A .600 pops to tree; B .400 and AA .420 enter frontier.
narration: Choose largest masses first. The heap starts with A. Taking it exposes just the next sibling, B, and the first child, A A.

visual: AA .420 wins over B .400; add node; reveal AB .180 and AAA .336 in queue.
narration: A A wins. Its sibling scores point one eight; its child scores point three three six.

visual: B .400 pops before AAA .336; B branch appears and BA .280 joins queue.
narration: Now B wins over the deeper A A A. Taking B exposes B A, with mass point two eight. Width and depth compete in the same priority queue.

visual: AAA then BA fill final two slots; BAA .224 remains outside budget.
narration: Take A A A, then B A. Five slots are full. B A A stays outside. The implementation uses sums of logs for numerical stability.

visual: Tree nodes group by depth; depth sums 1.000, .700, .336 accumulate to 2.036.
narration: Add selected masses by depth: one, point seven, point three three six. Expected matches under Q: two point zero three six.

visual: Budget3 keeps A AA B on left; concentrated marginals on right grow A AA AAA.
narration: Compare with three slots. These marginals buy a branch. Put point nine on A at the first two positions, and the winners form a chain.

visual: Concentrated .900 .810 .648 appear; Q-only optimum underlined; target conditional branch remains distinct.
narration: These products favor the chain. Selection is optimal for Q, not necessarily for target acceptance or latency.

purpose: Compile flattened input and depth positions
visual: Restore main tree, copy nodes into flat array b A A B A A; depths 0 1 2 1 3 2 align.
narration: Verify our five-node tree. Flatten tokens in construction order, but assign positions by depth. Siblings share positions; storage indices are not language positions.

visual: Six by six mask appears; BA row lights b B BA, while A branch stays blocked.
narration: The B A node may attend to the cached context, the root, B, and itself. It must not see the other branch. The mask enforces precisely that ancestry.

visual: All allowed mask cells fill; one target pass lights all node outputs; two different condition labels reveal.
narration: One target pass scores every selected path, with path-conditioned outputs. A prediction after B can differ from a prediction after A.

visual: Mask exits; target choices appear beside root B, B A, BA B; root pointer follows B despite A larger draft score.
narration: In this toy outcome, the target chooses B at the root, despite A's larger draft score. B is a child, so follow it.

visual: B output A highlighted, walk to BA, append actual A in output strip.
narration: At B, the target output chooses A. That child exists too. Follow it without another forward pass. Two speculative tokens have matched.

purpose: Stop on unmatched token, do not discard
visual: BA output B reveals absent child; output receives outlined B marked next root, not cache-processed.
narration: At B A, the target chooses B. No child matches: stop the walk. Emit this token as the next bonus, still unprocessed by the target.

purpose: Clarify no rejection ratio and stopping variants
visual: Target-choice chip changes greedy to sampled; missing-child and leaf symbols converge on next bonus; EOS truncation strip.
narration: Follow target choices, greedy or sampled, without acceptance ratios. Leaves also end the walk. Generation respects token limits and retains the first stop token.

visual: Cache cells b A AA B AAA BA filter into b B BA; bonus B remains outside cache.
narration: Compact the target cache to the processed path: b, B, A. Discard unused branches. Keep the newly selected bonus outside that cache until the next round processes it.

purpose: Show the payoff and cost boundary
visual: Next bonus shifts into root while unused distributions leave; one drafter pass, build, target pass, compact aligned as cost stages.
narration: Draft scores allocate paths; target conditionals choose tokens. More coverage costs tree construction, verification, and cache work.

visual: Budget dots link to surviving branch coverage; orange target path remains and next root starts new masks; compact source credit.
narration: D D tree buys more chances to continue. The target still chooses the tokens.
